local Animate = require "actions/Animate"
return function(self, player, prevState) if prevState == self.STATE_TOUCHING then self.scene.objectLookup.Door1:run(Animate(self.scene.objectLookup.Door1.sprite, "closing_right")) end end

local Animate = require "actions/Animate"
return function(self, player, prevState) if prevState == self.STATE_IDLE then self.scene.audio:playSfx("autodoor") self.scene.objectLookup.Door1:run(Animate(self.scene.objectLookup.Door1.sprite, "opening_right")) end end
